title: Deep RAG poisoning — crowding & false provenance
summary: Module 2. The trust-label filter from Module 1 is not enough. Beat it two ways — flood retrieval with near-duplicate poison, and mislabel a poison doc as trusted — then build a content-aware detector that catches both.
takeaway: Trust labels are spoofable and top-k is floodable. Defend on content, not just metadata.
design_rule: Detect instruction-shaped chunks and collapse near-duplicate crowding before context is built.
